text: This S1000D data module documents FOSSIG business rule decisions for Chapter 2.1. It is a new, unverified technical document issued January 9, 2019, in English (Canadian). The content indicates that detailed business rule decisions will be provided in a future issue; currently, the module serves as a placeholder for forthcoming specification material.

This is a Publication Module (PM) document that serves as a master table of contents and organizational guide for S1000D Free Open Source Software Interest Group (FOSSIG) technical documentation. Issued January 9, 2019, it structures the publication into front matter (title page, abbreviations, introduction) and three main chapters covering FOSSIG introduction, business rules, and the Standard Numbering System (SNS), with references to detailed data modules for each section.
